belts.name: Repository reader
belts.desc: Read a repository: files at a ref, a commit with its checks, and the pull requests in flight.

belts.name: Repository contributor
belts.desc: Propose changes: open a pull request, comment on one, and open a Context PR.

belts.name: Release control
belts.desc: Land and publish: merge a pull request, cut a release, delete the merged branch.
belts.note: Every tool here is irreversible or denied. A grant reaching this toolbelt still meets the policy at the call.

belts.name: Context graph
belts.desc: Search the workspace graph, traverse it, recall published records, and append new ones.

belts.name: Workstation
belts.desc: Act on the host checkout: run a command, replace a string in a file, fetch a URL.
belts.note: Harness-native. Delivered only to an agent on the harness tier or above, because nothing below it installs a hook.

belts.name: Issue tracker
belts.desc: Read an issue with its state and links, and change its state, assignee or labels.

belts.name: Messaging
belts.desc: Message another agent in the workspace, and post to a Slack channel the connection authorizes.

belts.name: Payments
belts.desc: Create and confirm a payment against a saved counterparty.
belts.note: Assigning this toolbelt authorizes nothing. A financial call is denied before dispatch unless the agent holds a mandate covering it.

belts.name: Cloud cost
belts.desc: Read cost and usage for a linked cloud account.
